effects.label: Foretell Failure
effects.text: before your next d20 check you learn whether a 10 on the die would succeed

system.description:
INSIGHT UTILITY

Tradition arcane, divinity, ethereal; Cast 1 AP (verbal)

You cast this spell immediately before you would take an action that requires a d20 roll, such as a skill check, attack roll, or saving throw. The action must be something you can complete in a single round. The spell magically informs you whether the action will succeed if you roll a 10 or better on the d20 roll involved. If the action would be successful under those circumstances, you must take the action. If the action would not be successful, you can take a different action.

Automated: your next d20 check says first whether a 10 on the die would succeed, with every modifier it has. A skill action is asked before it spends anything: if a 10 would succeed it is taken; if not, you may take a different action and nothing is spent, and a DC the GM sets afterwards is put to the GM while the action waits (B8-6). A Strike, a save or a casting's check is told at its roll, where it is already under way.
